collection_notes: Candidate has no existing positions, so no issue was 'already covered'. Federal-only issues (social-security-medicare, trade, foreign-policy) skipped per levels. Campaign site returned 503; KOIN questionnaire returned 403. Only usable source is The Cardinal Times (a student-run outlet, not in COLLECTOR.md's T3 list; tier T3 assigned, verifier should confirm acceptability). Match rests on the article naming him as a 2026 District 4 candidate. WebSearch summaries wrongly attributed other candidates' 2024 Mercury positions to Goldsmith; fetching showed his Mercury section has none, so none were used.
